title: Architect, Technology I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Architect, Technology I owns the architecture of the enterprise cloud data platform and leads a team of developers, working with limited supervision. The role also directs a very large offshore team across multiple time zones, setting technical direction, standards, and roadmaps so work stays consistent at scale. The architect applies advanced technical knowledge to complex assignments, independently leads technical components of larger initiatives, and supports business growth and technology integration in a regulated environment.
Responsibilities:
Perform technical and analytical tasks using established methods and tools; apply judgment to adapt approaches for less-routine problems, document methods and results, and escalate novel or ambiguous issues with suggested next steps.
Lead and mentor a team of developers, and direct a large offshore team, setting priorities, coordinating handoffs across time zones, and holding delivery to quality and architecture standards.
Review design artifacts and enforce standards through peer reviews, architecture principles, and documented compliance evidence. Support governance and compliance tracking by maintaining architecture repositories, updating standards documentation, and coordinating audit preparations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams on implementation by providing architecture guidance, reviewing technical designs, and validating integration points.
Define and evolve data platform architecture, including Lakehouse, data mesh and data fabric patterns, event-driven designs, and batch and real-time processing.
Establish data contracts, data quality, observability, lineage, and metadata practices for reusable data products and platform services.
Design for scalability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, security, and cost optimization.
Identify automation and process improvements by evaluating tooling options, implementing validation scripts, and streamlining documentation workflows.
Maintain architecture documentation and guidelines by updating models, capturing design decisions, and keeping them accessible to project teams.
Deliver reliable outputs for assigned and moderately complex projects; ensure acceptance criteria and compliance requirements are met, document methods, validations, and key assumptions, and keep project leads, stakeholders, and leadership informed of progress and issues.
Required:
Bachelor’s Degree 7 years of experience, or Master’s Degree 6 years of experience, or PhD 2 years of experience.
Significant hands-on experience building and operationalizing enterprise-scale cloud big data platforms.
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering architectures, including cloud-native data platforms, Lakehouse architecture, data mesh and data fabric concepts, event driven architectures, and batch and real-time data processing.
Familiarity with open table formats and interoperable data ecosystems, such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
Experience building reliable data pipelines, data products, and reusable platform services.
Knowledge of data quality, observability, lineage, metadata management, and data governance.
Experience defining and implementing data contracts covering schemas, semantics, quality expectations, ownership, and access policies.
Understanding of data security, privacy, identity and access management, encryption, regulatory requirements, and responsible data use.
Experience designing for scalability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Familiarity with modern data development and orchestration tools, such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or comparable technologies.
Experience with serverless architectures including Kubernetes, AWS EKS, and AWS Fargate.
Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams.
Demonstrated ability to mentor technical staff, lead cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives to completion.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to operate with high autonomy and minimal supervision, proactively managing stakeholder expectations and keeping leadership informed through clear, concise verbal and written communication.
Preferred
Exposure to or experience with Cloudera Data Platform or another legacy big-data environment (a significant plus).
Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or other highly regulated environments.
Experience working with international development teams across multiple time zones.
Exposure to graph databases and GraphQL.

Minimum of 10 years related experience is preferred.
Experience in curricula development

Experience managing a team

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Knowledge of FDA and regulatory statutes as applied to Allergan Aesthetics products, with the ability to function in an environment controlled by outside regulatory entities.

The Associate Director of Marketing Research & Analytics for Eye Care will be an indispensable business partner, focused on increasing market place success – by designing, implementing, managing, analyzing, and effectively communicating marketing research and analytics initiatives for Eye Care on behalf of APEX. Act as an intelligence partner focused on providing strategic insights, forming a trusted relationship, and staying abreast of commercial issues and trends within the Eye Care space.

Leverage innovative, sophisticated analytic models that address critical issues, but also meet key business criteria. Be able to effectively communicate the results of these complex analytic models and influence action to improve brand performance.

Promote a culture of proactive communication, appreciation of diverse points of view, and recognition to facilitate psychological safety across the team.

Ensure all research and analytics activities are conducted in accordance with financial and ethical compliance guidelines.
BA or BS degree required. Advanced degree (MA, MS, MBA, PhD) preferred.
10+ years relevant marketing research and/or analytics experience required.
Experience in Eye Care industry, Over the Counter (OTC) and pharmaceutical syndicated data sources is preferred.
Analytical reasoning abilities, intellectual curiosity, strong business acumen, superior organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and creativity in problem-solving.
Ability to interact effectively with/present to (verbally and in writing) all levels of the organization.
Proven experience as an integral member of a high-performing work team.

Strong leadership skills and the ability to collaborate effectively cross-functionally within the organization and with external agencies.

The LBA Operations lab within Quantitative Translational & ADME Sciences (QTAS) in Worcester, MA, is seeking a motivated, independent, and experienced automation Scientist to support pre-clinical bioanalytical programs in a non-regulated and fast-paced environment. This role focuses on 1) the bioanalysis of animal samples dosed with large molecule therapeutics, including pharmacokinetic (PK), toxicokinetic (TK) pharmacodynamic (PD), and anti-drug-antibody (ADA) studies using manual and automated Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) assay protocols; and 2) designing and optimizing new automation protocols for the LBA workflow on Tecan and Hamilton liquid handlers.
The primary responsibilities of the Scientist I/II role include developing and executing bioanalytical strategies to support PK, PD, TK, and ADA studies via LBA using automated liquid handling systems. This lab-based role focuses on bioanalytical assay design, planning, data interpretation, and application of automation knowledge to increase analytical capabilities in support of oncology, immunology, and neuroscience portfolios.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioanalysis, biochemistry, chemistry, or related fields along with bioanalytical assay automation. The candidate is expected to execute bioanalytical assay design and data interpretation, while driving automation strategies for pre-clinical sample analysis.

Design and execute pre-clinical (rodent, NHP) bioanalytical studies using newly developed or existing bioanalytical protocols using manual and automated LBA protocols (Hamilton and Tecan instruments).
Serve as an automation SME for the lab and set up automated assay strategies for large molecule bioanalysis.
Effectively and clearly communicate assay plans, timelines, results, and data interpretations with study teams and QTAS stakeholders.
Train and mentor junior scientists on LBA protocols using automation.
Archive data in ELN and LIMS systems.
Write and update experimental protocols and procedures.
Initiate, design, interpret, and troubleshoot operational assays independently and efficiently.
Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, or pharmacology with 7+ years industry experience or MS or equivalent with 5+ years of experience.
Previous experience conducting PK/PD/TK bioanalysis on antibodies, bi/multi-specifics and/or ADCs, including data interpretation is required.
Highly motivated, reliable, and independent contributor with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Experience with assay development and troubleshooting using ligand binding workflows (ELISA, MSD) is a must. Automation experience is required.
Team player. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with computers and data analysis software, including LIMS systems.
Ability to design, summarize, communicate, and interpret bioanalytical results.
Creative leader and problem solver who collaborates effectively in a highly matrixed environment.  This position is onsite and located at the AbbVie Bioresearch Center in Worcester, MA.

description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced communications manager based in Austin, Texas, to serve as the embedded communications partner for Customer Operations and the Austin site. This individual will work closely with local leaders and employees to strengthen communication, engagement, and connection while supporting broader Allergan Aesthetics U.S. Commercial priorities.
A core focus of the role will be establishing a strong, consistent cadence of Austin site and leadership communications, including quarterly and end-of-quarter updates, local town halls, site materials, employee announcements, and engagement campaigns. Through close partnership with Austin colleagues, the Manager will develop a deep understanding of the organization, its people, and the end-to-end customer experience.
Building on that foundation, the Manager will provide increasingly strategic communications support for Customer Operations programs, milestones, and operational initiatives. This individual will translate complex topics into clear, coordinated communications, connect Customer Operations work to broader commercial priorities, and help anticipate communications needs, opportunities, and risks.
As a member of the broader Corporate & Commercial Communications team, this individual will collaborate regularly with communications colleagues while operating day to day alongside the Austin-based leaders and employees they support. The role requires a proactive, highly independent communications professional who can build trusted relationships, readily integrate into projects, and manage work from strategy and stakeholder counsel through development, approvals, and execution.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Operations Communications
Build a working knowledge of Customer Operations, the Allergan Aesthetics product portfolio, and the end-to-end customer experience to provide increasingly strategic and informed communications counsel.
Develop and execute communications plans for Customer Operations programs, milestones, and operational excellence initiatives, connecting the work to broader U.S. Commercial priorities and the Allergan Aesthetics brand.
Translate complex operational information into clear, relevant, and actionable communications.
Proactively build relationships with project teams and subject-matter experts; embed within relevant initiatives; and identify communications needs, opportunities, and risks.
Develop a working understanding of order management, distribution, and related processes, partnering with subject-matter experts to communicate operational topics accurately and effectively.
Develop and manage communications for operational initiatives, recurring business needs, disruptions, emerging issues, and other time-sensitive developments affecting the employee or customer experience.
Exercise independent judgment to develop recommendations, propose solutions, establish next steps, and advance work with appropriate leadership oversight.
Maintain an integrated Customer Operations communications calendar and provide visibility into upcoming milestones and audience impacts.
Establish appropriate feedback and measurement mechanisms to assess communications effectiveness and inform future planning.
Employee Engagement
Serve as a trusted communications partner to Austin site leaders and their teams, becoming a visible and integrated member of the local organization.
Lead planning and content development for quarterly and end-of-quarter leadership communications, local town halls, employee meetings, organizational announcements, and other recurring site communications.
Establish and manage an effective communications and engagement cadence for Austin employees, ensuring timely visibility into business priorities, site developments, and opportunities to participate.
Develop creative communications campaigns and employee experiences in partnership with Austin leaders and relevant functions to bring colleagues together, strengthen connection to the organization, and build awareness, participation, and community around shared priorities.
Help leaders communicate business, operational, and workplace priorities with clarity and appropriate context, bringing forward recommendations when communications needs, opportunities, or risks emerge.
Cross-Functional Initiatives and Special Projects
Partner with the Allergan Aesthetics Corporate & Commercial Communications function on sensitive or high-impact communications affecting customers, field teams, or the broader business.
Support select cross-functional initiatives involving Inside Sales, and other Corporate & Commercial Communications priorities.
Collaborate regularly with Corporate & Commercial Communications colleagues while remaining closely connected to Austin-based leaders and teams, ensuring messaging consistency and alignment across the organization.
Communications Governance and Operational Excellence
Independently drive assigned workstreams from discovery and strategic recommendation through stakeholder alignment, approvals, execution, and measurement.

title: Scientist II / Senior Scientist I, tLNP Process Development
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNPs) represent a key new modality to enable effective delivery of mRNA. The tLNP chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) team (TCT) is a newly formed group under Biologics CMC, Development Sciences, R&D. TCT focuses on process development for tLNPs, including mRNA process development, tLNP process development, and formulation development.
The tLNP Process Development team is seeking a highly motivated, talented, and innovative scientist with expertise in mRNA-LNP process development and an interest in laboratory automation. This team is responsible for the end-to-end manufacturing process from purified mRNA to purified tLNP bulk drug product, including encapsulating mRNA with lipid components to form LNPs, conjugating LNPs with a targeting moiety, and purifying the final tLNPs via tangential flow filtration (TFF).
The successful candidate will help advance fundamental understanding of tLNP unit operations, such as mRNA encapsulation, bioconjugation, and TFF, as well as scaling up lab processes into pre-clinical, clinical, and commercial scale manufacturing processes. The candidate will also apply automation expertise to integrate off-the-shelf and custom-built hardware, software, and data workflows into flexible experimental platforms that increase throughput, reproducibility, and process understanding.
The end goal for tLNP Process Development team is to deliver a robust manufacturing process at commercial scale. This includes science-based, hands-on approaches in the lab to optimize process parameters and understand the impact of process parameters on critical quality attributes. First-principle-based and statistical modeling will be applied where appropriate. Along the pharmaceutical development life cycle, the team will be responsible for successful production of non-GMP pre-clinical safety study supplies and GMP clinical study supplies from a manufacturing plant on site or at third party manufacturers. The team will also lead the tech transfer of commercial processes into a commercial facility. Additionally, the team reviews appropriate sections of Common Technical Document (CTD) for regulatory submissions.
Success in this role depends on close collaboration with the mRNA process development, drug product development, and analytical development, digital and automation partners, as well as cross-functional partners across Biologics CMC and Synthetic Molecule CMC. The work directly advances cutting-edge mRNA-based therapeutics.
Responsibilities
Independently design, execute and interpret critical experiments to understand unit operations such as mRNA encapsulation, bioconjugation, and tangential flow filtration, and scale up these unit operations to commercial manufacturing batch size.
Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory research or method development, requiring minimal direction from supervisor.
May initiate new areas of investigation that are scientifically meaningful, reliable, and can be incorporated directly into a research or development program.
Demonstrates high proficiency across a wide range of technologies relevant to tLNP process development.
Formulate conclusions and design follow-on experiments based on multidisciplinary data.
Primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents.
Proactively develop and implement innovative automation solutions (custom and off-the-shelf equipment).
Apply AI tools for structured data capture, analysis, and predictive modeling.
Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, and GMP compliance.
Direct mentorship of others.
BS, MS, or PhD degree in Chemistry, Material Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent.
Senior Scientist I :  BS with 10+ years', MS with 8+ years', and PhD with 0+ years' industry experience.
Scientist II : BS with 7+ years', MS with 5+ years' industry experience.
Experience with LNP mixing technology in an academic lab, or industry experience with LNP drug product process development. For mRNA encapsulation, experience with systems such as impinging jet, coaxial jet, or multi-inlet vortex mixer is required.
Possess thorough theoretical and practical understanding of mRNA encapsulation.
Experience with bioconjugation is required.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and interpret critical experiments to answer scientific questions.
Demonstrated ability to learn, understand, and master new experimental techniques.
Ability to multitask and work within timelines.
Demonstrated scientific writing skills and strong verbal communication skills.
Preferred Experience

The Translational Sciences group within Neuroscience Discovery Research is actively engaged in an innovative research program dedicated to identifying and strengthening biomarkers and translational endpoints to support AbbVie’s therapeutic programs. Working across the Neuroscience portfolio, which includes assets in neurodegeneration, movement disorders, psychiatry, and migraine, our comprehensive approach includes the discovery and development of novel positron emission tomography (PET) radioligands, as well as the application of PET, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and related imaging methods in drug discovery and development.
Within Translational Sciences, the Image Analysis team provides quantitative image analysis expertise to projects across the portfolio, working closely with other groups at AbbVie, leading academic institutions, and CROs. Major Responsibilities:
Quantify preclinical and clinical PET and MR imaging data, and interpret the results.
Apply PET compartmental and graphical kinetic models, including plasma input and reference tissue methods, to characterize novel radioligands and assess target engagement.
Quantify structural, diffusion, and functional MRI data.
Support whole-body PET imaging and dosimetry analysis.
Develop, validate, and document Python-based image processing pipelines and novel methodology.
Curate and quality control imaging data, and help administer the group's data platforms.
Provide input on endpoint selection, study design, and the implementation of imaging in trials.
Collaborate with imaging CROs and provide technical oversight of externally executed analyses.
Communicate results and contribute to study reports, regulatory documents, and publications.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in medical physics, biomedical engineering, computer science, neuroscience, or a related field, with typically 10–12 years of experience; or a master’s degree or equivalent education, with typically 8–10 years of experience; or a PhD, with no experience necessary to typically 4 years of experience, depending on the Senior Scientist level (I or II)
Demonstrated skills in the quantitative analysis of PET and/or MR imaging data.
Proficiency in scientific programming, with Python or additional relevant languages required (e.g., MATLAB, R, C/C++), and strong Linux skills.
Working knowledge of analysis tools (e.g., FSL, FreeSurfer, SPM, ANTs, or PMOD) and PACS/DICOM.
Capacity to work effectively and independently in multidisciplinary teams and meet deadlines.
Good publication record in international peer-reviewed journals.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Additional strengths include experience in the following areas:
PET kinetic modeling and receptor occupancy studies, as well as preclinical rodent and NHP imaging.
Production image processing pipelines, with Git, containerization, and testing; HPC or cloud.
Imaging data management platforms (e.g., Flywheel) and DICOM curation; GxP imaging data.
Machine learning and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code).
Analysis of large multi-site human imaging cohorts, including harmonization across sites and integration of imaging with clinical or omics measures.

Partner with HRIT and Process Optimization to support automation design, implementation, testing, and validation.

Track and report the operational impact of implemented enhancements, including efficiency gains, reduced manual effort, and improved user experience.

Partner with subject matter experts to develop and update standard operating procedures, system documentation, and knowledge articles.

Monitor knowledge effectiveness, adoption, and recurring support needs and recommend improvements to support operational efficiency and self-service.

Maintain system process documentation, workflow inventories, enhancement records, and change logs.

Provide operational insights and recommendations to support TA technology planning and continuous-improvement priorities.

3+ years of experience in business operations, systems analysis, reporting and analytics, HR technology, process improvement, or related functions.
Experience generating reports, analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and developing business-focused recommendations.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, and trend analysis.

Experience documenting business requirements, workflows, and process improvements.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

description:
The Opportunity
Adobe's Digital Video & Audio (DVA) business builds Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Media Encoder, the tools that filmmakers, broadcasters, and creators trust to tell their stories. At the center of these products sits the Realtime Experience (RTX) team. RTX owns the rendering engine, GPU abstraction layer, compositor, video player, importer and exporter host, and Effects and Transitions SDK. Every frame our customers play, edit, and export passes through this stack.
The next 12 months will define the future of video creation at Adobe. RTX is finishing its GPU-first pipeline, moving to a modern graphics API, and designing how AI-native rendering fits in. Leader for this team will shape the engine under Premiere Pro and After Effects for years to come.
We are hiring a Director of Engineering for RTX. The team is senior and highly specialized, and it needs a leader with matching depth. The Director will own these modernization efforts and align the many teams that touch rendering, as Topaz and LTX integrations arrive.
What You Will Do
This role sets the technical vision for the rendering technology behind DVA's desktop products, with a near-term focus on Premiere Pro performance and stability. Architectural decisions come with clear investment plans for engineering and quality engineering.
Deliver the GPU-first rendering pipeline to improve playback, scrubbing, and dropped frames.
Choose and lead the move to a modern graphics and compute API such as DirectX 12, Vulkan, or Dawn/WebGPU.
Define how AI features and partner technologies such as Topaz and LTX fit the render pipeline while keeping quality and user experience high.
Unify rendering, effects, and transitions across desktop, web, and mobile.
Build lasting partnerships with technology leaders and shape our roadmap around their platform plans.
Work with media and format teams to modernize legacy components, and align partner teams on shared priorities.
Lead the engineering side of a Developer Relations effort to unify and document our SDKs and raise third-party plugin quality, protecting a key competitive advantage.
The Director also grows a team of managers, architects, and senior engineers, protects the quality bar, and coaches leaders as the organization changes.
What We Are Looking For (Must Have)
Are you a technical leader whose judgment shapes the product? The ideal candidate does not need to write shaders, but knows which paths lead to great outcomes and can defend that view to engineers, partners, and executives.
12+ years of software engineering experience, with deep architectural judgment in GPU-accelerated, real-time rendering, graphics, or media systems.
5+ years leading engineering teams, with proven people leadership at senior engineering manager level or above, including developing managers and growing careers.
Experience building or leading performance-critical software such as rendering engines, playback and compositing systems, game engines, or broadcast tools.
Strong knowledge of GPU architecture and compute, and of modern graphics APIs including Metal, DirectX 12, Vulkan, and WebGPU.
A track record in large, mature C/C++ desktop codebases, modernizing them while continuing to ship.
A clear point of view on where rendering technology is heading, and the skill to turn it into a funded, staffed plan.
Strong influence across Product, Engineering, QE, and external partners.

Understanding of video codecs, formats, and import and export pipelines, and how they affect playback and effects.
Experience in games, VFX, AR/VR, real-time 3D, or live broadcast production.
Experience adding AI or ML inference to rendering or media pipelines.
Experience unifying rendering across desktop, web, and mobile.
Experience building developer ecosystems, SDKs, or plugin programs.

title: Product Manager, LATAM (Miami or San Francisco)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Our Product Marketing team imagines the ideal experience for our community and works backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a product strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented, hands on and excellent communicators, capable of crafting compelling stories for both internal and external audiences.
The Difference You Will Make:
The International Product Marketing team is part of the Worldwide Product Marketing team. We are looking for entrepreneurial product experts who are ready to jump in, roll their sleeves up and integrate with local and regional teams, while maintaining close alignment with the worldwide teams. This role will help build out the new functional area outside of the US and will be instrumental in shaping the organization as it evolves. The cross functional model we use at Airbnb requires close partnerships  across multiple teams – this role requires a highly collaborative, flexible individual who can influence and collaborate with teams across the world.
As the Product Manager based in our LATAM region, you will report to the Product Marketing Director for International Markets. As the product marketing leader for the market(s) in LATAM, you will play a pivotal role in understanding the needs, pain points, and behavior of users and translate those insights into innovative product features, capabilities and marketing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the travel industry at a market and broader regional level, and have a proven track record of driving product innovation. You will collaborate with the global business and country teams to develop partnerships that accelerate existing and new businesses. You will drive features  in major releases and for test and learn pilots, after having successfully championed customization and features for your target country/region. You will also determine how they are communicated to the public and the media in your region in partnership with other communications and marketing teams. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release. You will be the voice of our products for the market in your region and love the journey from taking a product from idea to reality.
A Typical Day:
Build deep expertise on Airbnb in your market/region through user research, marketplace data, and an understanding of the competitive landscape and be capable of synthesizing in a cohort product story input from multiple stakeholders and sources.
Work with other functional leaders in your market/region to articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Airbnb products and new businesses.
Implement best-in-class product development and management practices, including relevant go-to-market kits and information packs for local teams, while working with central and local teams.
Maintain and articulate a product feature and roadmap prioritization plan in collaboration with local teams.
Advocate for and execute new products that deliver impact for our business and users.
Communicate concisely and influence outcomes across all levels of the company, including country and regional executive teams.
Drive alignment across product teams (Technology, Design) and key cross-functional partners (Business, Supply, FP&A, Marketing, Global Operations, Customer Support, Trust, etc.) to ensure initiatives are prioritized for wider roll-out or piloted to test and learn
Define goals and success with clearly measurable objectives and key results for your area.
Build and seamlessly integrate partnerships in your country/region that expand existing businesses and build new ones.
Navigate regulatory and government requirements in partnership with Policy/Comms and regions/markets.
Craft the product narrative and marketing strategies that communicate the benefits and features of our products both internally and externally in collaboration with comms and other cross functional partners.
Develop and deliver engaging product demos to press, showcasing key features and functionalities.
Your Expertise:
10-15 years of product management experience.
Demonstrated track record of product leadership.
Comfortable with doing individual contributor product management work.
Success in building and scaling global consumer products and ecosystems that people love.
Experience creating product messaging and delivering to customers and the media.
Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality – start up experience a plus while capable of operating in a larger organization.
Ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy/decisions.
Capable of driving execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.
Highly collaborative and results oriented.
Strong AI fluency: hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day product work (research, analysis, prototyping, communications).
Ability to spot where AI can improve products and team workflows, and turn those opportunities into shipped outcomes.
Ability and willingness to travel frequently (30-35% of the time).
Fluency in English and at least one other local language (Spanish or Portuguese).

title: Product Manager, Social Features
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Our Product Marketing Managers start with the guest and work backwards, turning product thinking, data, and research into strategy. They own outcomes end to end, lead cross-functional teams across engineering, design, data science, and program management, and stay close enough to the details to know when something is off.
The Social team is making Airbnb a place where you travel with, and because of, the people you know. Our strategy has three parts: scaling the social graph, building social features that make Airbnb fun and useful for you and your friends, and creating social experiences that help people form new relationships and strengthen existing ones in real life. Each part has its own dedicated pod of engineers, designers, and program partners.
The Difference You Will Make
As Product Marketing Manager for Social Features, you'll lead a new pod that turns guests' connections into reasons to come back to Airbnb. You'll own the features people use with their friends: the travel map and sharing it, group travel tools, recommendations from people you know, and how connections are woven across Airbnb to make the whole travel experience better. You'll own the outcome, not just the roadmap: you'll make the calls on scope and priority with a dedicated engineering lead, engineers, and design partner, and be accountable for the results. You'll take features from brief to launch, use experiment results to decide what to build next, and grow how often guests plan, book, and share trips with the people they know. You'll also write the product narrative that explains each release to leadership and to guests.

Work backwards from the guest: write crisp briefs and requirements for new features, each grounded in a real guest need and a clear definition of success
Prototype with AI first: build working prototypes yourself to explore ideas, test them with guests, and align the team in days rather than weeks

Shape how connections are integrated across the guest journey, from search and booking to Trips, so planning and traveling with people you know feels natural

Design for trust and privacy from the start, with clear controls over what people share and with whom

Present strategy and results in leadership reviews, turning complex tradeoffs into clear decisions and concise narratives

Comfort working in a new, fast-moving area where you set the roadmap and build the team's operating rhythm

Requirements — Translate the vision into clear, prioritized product requirements that engineering and operations can build from.

Quality improvement — Identify quality gaps from the data (service misses, exceptions, defects, failure modes) and drive the highest-impact improvements back into the product and network.

Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.

Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle from vision through launch, measurement, and continuous quality improvement — and turning a complex transportation network into a scalable, benchmark-beating 2-day shipping product that shippers choose.

title: Senior Security Engineering Manager - Agentic Detection & Threat Hunting
description:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.
Our team is built around two halves that learn from each other quickly. One half builds the on-host detection and response agent that runs across Apple's datacenter fleet. The other half, which you will lead, builds the fleet-scale detection and response platform that sits above those hosts. It fuses signals from hosts, applications, cloud control planes and identity into a small stream of high-confidence security findings, and it applies agentic AI to detection, triage, response and threat hunting so that machines do the work that humans cannot scale to do. The two halves depend on each other, and the speed of the feedback loop between them is one of the team's greatest strengths.
We are looking for a Senior Manager who is a builder first. This role is technical and hands-on. You will manage a team of experienced engineers, and you will work as a close peer with the manager of the on-host agent team. You will work with partner teams across Apple's security organization on delivery, platform dependencies and operations. 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping production software or data systems. You are technical enough to be credible with senior individual contributors and to challenge their architecture decisions on equal footing.

title: Senior Security Software Engineer EDR
description:

We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.
A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It is a Swift-based agent that runs on Linux (x86 and ARM64) and on Apple operating systems running on Apple silicon. It collects security telemetry, evaluates detections directly on the host, and takes response action on the host. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.
We are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us grow this agent to protect a very large fleet, and to do it without ever taking production down. You will bring two things at once: the engineering depth to ship new capabilities quickly, and a reliability mindset that treats every release as something that runs on production hosts. You will take vague, high-stakes problems and turn them into working software, working with other teams to find out what to build and how. This is not a role where you will be handed pre-defined tickets.

Personal proficiency, in at least one high-level or scripting language (Python or Rust) and at least one low-level systems language (C or C++).
Solid knowledge of operating system internals (processes, threads, memory, system calls, namespaces). Linux, macOS or both.
Credible understanding of attacker behavior and security concepts, and of how malicious activity shows up in host telemetry such as process, network and file events.
Preferred qualifications: Experience building or operating endpoint, host or agent software deployed at large scale, with performance and availability objectives.
Experience with eBPF, EndpointSecurity or similar OS-level instrumentation, and an understanding of how those mechanisms can be evaded or disabled.
Experience with Swift on server, concurrency in Swift, and cross-platform builds.
Understanding of EDR or host-based detection techniques and the current industry state of the art.
Experience with policy-driven detection logic (for example OPA/Rego), and with statistical techniques such as probabilistic data structures for bounded-memory anomaly detection.

title: Safety and Abuse Test Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking to grow the safety and abuse team at Base with the addition of a test engineer who will focus on testing our in-house designs up to and past their limits, ensuring the safety of our members and employees is maintained at all times in the product lifecycle.

 

As a member of the safety and abuse team under hardware at Base, you will review new and existing designs, identify issues requiring test coverage, plan, design, and execute said tests, communicating those results effectively to key stakeholders. Some tests are required by governing bodies which we run in-house or at external labs to achieve product compliance. You will also work on increasing test throughput, quality, and generally optimize the spaces we use to run these tests. You will work closely with other test engineers, technicians, and designers.

 

Much of the work will be done at a satellite test laboratory designed, built, and operated by Base, less than an hour’s drive from HQ in Austin Texas (transportation provided). This lab is a primarily outdoor space and applicants can expect to be working hands on. The majority of your time will be spent at this satellite lab during sprints, with time spent in the office as well.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate systems for safety using DFMEA and similar tools

 - Design test setups and execute safety and abuse testing, including but not limited to:
   
   - Thermal runaway testing of batteries
   
   - Short circuit testing of batteries and inverters
   
   - Switch interruption testing (at full voltage)

 - Own the safety of safety/abuse test setups

 - Find and manage space to execute safety and abuse testing

 - Set up data acquisition for all safety/abuse tests, including: thermocouples, voltage or current measurement, accelerometer measurement, etc

 - Write world class test reports
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3 years of designing and running tests on electrical equipment

 - Experience with working around lithium ion batteries / high voltage / DAQ systems

 - Hands on experience with battery thermal runaway is a plus

 - UL 9540 / UL 1973 exposure a plus



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

We are looking for a digital-first Associate Video Producer who is excited to build their skills in writing, shooting, producing, editing and, most importantly, telling great stories.

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality.

description:
About the Team
Our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team is re-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first-party and third-party operations businesses. DashMarts are our first-party offering designed to provide on-demand deliveries by selling household essentials, groceries, brand-name favorites, local favorites and so much more. The end to end DashMart experience is powered through DoorDash. Third-party partnerships enable us to offer on-demand deliveries from both SMB and enterprise merchants across grocery, convenience alcohol and retail storefronts. The merchants own the inventory, we fulfill and deliver them! Our Central Operations team is the heartbeat of the New Verticals Strategy & Operations team that enables us to power a robust logistic platform through a high-quality, speedy and efficient network - for both DashMarts and third party partners.
About the Role
We’re looking to hire a few Senior Associates within our Central Strategy & Operations that will help shape our strategy around delivery efficiency, leveraging both operational and product levers to build logistics systems and frameworks. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution, with end-to-end ownership of key efficiency drivers and their impact on our business. Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance, you will translate complex data into actionable insights and initiatives that improve efficiency, elevate the customer experience, and strengthen our bottom line. You will play a critical role in designing new systems, optimizing existing operations, and ensuring we continuously improve as we grow. We operate in a hybrid model - you will spend some time in your home office, in person via offsites and on-site in DashMarts as well. You will report into an Associate Manager on the role.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build. You’ll have your fingerprints all over DoorDash’s next big business. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch, get 1% better every day, and scale something completely new. This means everything from high-level strategy to nitty-gritty operational details.
Test & implement. You will identify operational gaps, identify product features and test/scale those product builds in partnership with product & engineering.

Lead and collaborate. You’ll work with a cross-functional team, including local operations, engineering, and product.
We’re excited about you because…
You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking. You are a self-starter. You don’t wait for others to point you at a problem. You are innately curious and take initiative to truth seek and investigate opportunities.
You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team. No job is beneath you.

You’re analytical. You let data win arguments, and you’re comfortable pulling your own data in SQL or modeling in Excel.

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts.  Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. Source candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and direct outreach, and keep pipelines active in our ATS.

Hands-on experience with an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
Organized and reliable across a mixed load of reqs at different stages.

Experience in manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain companies.
Familiarity with structured interviewing and scorecards.
Experience supporting high-volume hiring.

Remote position; standard computer-based work with extended periods of sitting. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. Travel expectations for this role are 0–10%.

Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan
Paid parental leave
Paid volunteer days
And more

title: Regional Sales Director, Territory Sales
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
The Regional Sales Director is the frontline leader of a territory squad of six to eight field account executives plus sales support, inside the national Territory Field Sales organization, the primary revenue engine of MISUMI Americas. This is the layer where strategy becomes execution: the Director owns a defined territory sales plan and a team of quota-carrying AEs, and personally engages the most strategic customers.
Much of today's territory motion reflects MISUMI's catalog heritage: responsive, transactional, and product-led. The Director coaches the team to sell the full solution (Custom, Configurable, and Standard components), expanding share of wallet in the installed base and building durable, consultative relationships with plant and engineering leadership. Success is equal parts people leadership (hiring, coaching, and developing sellers) and in-the-field selling alongside them on the accounts that matter most.
This role reports to the Vice President, Territory Sales, and partners with the Emerging Accounts team on coverage and account development across the territory.
Areas of Responsibility
Lead & Develop the Territory Team
Build, lead, coach, and scale a high-performing squad of 6–8 field account executives and sales support across a defined territory.
Recruit, develop, and retain top sales talent in partnership with HR; upgrade the team against a clear performance bar.`
Coach AEs on applying technical, product, and customer knowledge to influence design and purchase decisions and drive high post-sale satisfaction.
Run a consistent coaching cadence (ride-alongs, deal reviews, and 1:1s) tied to pipeline and attainment.
Own the Territory Sales Plan
Own the territory revenue number: forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and quota attainment across the squad.
Set and manage territory coverage, account tiering, and AE quotas in partnership with the VP, Territory Sales.
Establish operating rigor: CRM/Salesforce discipline, pipeline inspection, win/loss review, and KPI tracking.
Identify when a territory or seller needs intervention and act early with a clear plan.
Full-Solution, Value-Based Selling
Drive the shift from transactional, catalog-led selling to consultative, value-based selling across the team.
Coach the squad to sell the entire solution offering (Custom, Configurable, and Standard components) rather than defaulting to the historical standard-catalog motion.
Embed the MEDDPICC-based discovery and qualification framework in everyday deal management.
Call on customer decision-makers (executives, design engineers, and procurement leaders) and deliver compelling value propositions.
Customer Relationships & Installed-Base Expansion
Drive adoption, expansion, and retention across the installed base, growing share of wallet in existing accounts.
Build executive-level relationships with strategic accounts and serve as the escalation point for high-impact situations.
Proactively manage account health and mitigate churn and attrition risk across the territory.
Identify and pursue new business and key-account opportunities to grow market share in the territory.
Operating Excellence & Field Presence
Implement scalable processes, playbooks, and tools for pipeline, onboarding, and account management across the squad.
Partner with Marketing, Product, Operations, and the broader commercial team to align offerings with territory needs.Spend roughly 50% of time in the field (with customers, at trade shows and industry events, and alongside AEs), staying current on trends and competitor activity.
Maintain and contribute to the Quality Management System (QMS).
Qualifications
Required
8–12+ years of progressive B2B sales experience in manufacturing or a technology-driven environment.
3–5+ years in a sales leadership role; has managed field sales teams across large territories, not just individual contributors
Proven track record meeting or exceeding sales targets in a leadership capacity.
Direct experience shifting a transactional or catalog-driven motion toward consultative, full-solution, value-based selling, with measurable results.
Deep understanding of the manufacturing lifecycle, supply chain, and mechanical / precision components.
Operating rigor: CRM/Salesforce discipline, pipeline analytics, territory design, and structured qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent).
Outstanding coaching, communication, executive presence, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Strongly Preferred
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA a plus.
Experience in industrial distribution, factory automation, precision components, or capital equipment (e.g., Grainger, Fastenal, MSC, Parker, Bosch Rexroth, SMC, Festo, Kennametal, or similar).
Experience selling a multi-product solution (custom, configurable, and standard, or equivalent breadth) rather than a single-line catalog.
Fluency in the MRO and plant-floor buyer and the behaviors being transformed.
Comfort applying AI and modern sales tools to seller productivity and account prioritization.
Leadership Character
A player-coach: energized by developing sellers and being in the field, not managing from a desk.
Grit and bias to action; comfortable experimenting, learning fast, and leading through change.
Direct, honest, and accountable; owns outcomes and takes challenge well.
Physical Demands
Standard office/remote work environment with extended periods of computer use, video calls, and phone work. Regular field activity requires the ability to travel by air and ground, visit customer plant floors and manufacturing facilities (which may require standing, walking, and personal protective equipment), and attend trade shows and industry events. Ability to travel approximately 50% annually in-territory and across the U.S. for customer visits, ride-alongs with account executives, trade shows and industry events, and team meetings and off-sites.

title: Account Executive I (Farmer)
description:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The opportunity:
The Sales team at Flexport is dedicated to fostering strong, lasting relationships with our existing clients, ensuring their success and maximizing the value they derive from our platform. As an Account Executive I (Farmer), you play a critical role in driving client success at Flexport — deepening your expertise on our platform, our clients, and the fundamentals of global trade. You will manage a portfolio of accounts where you develop the core skills every great Account Executive I (Farmer) needs: building relationships, running business reviews, and spotting early growth signals. You'll work with clear playbooks and close support from senior teammates as you build the instincts and product knowledge to grow into even more complex client work.
You will:
- Manage a portfolio of Flexport clients, developing trusted relationships and driving strong satisfaction and retention through consistent, proactive engagement.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client communications, running regular business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) with support from structured templates and senior teammates.
- Identify and surface early cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your accounts, partnering with senior Account Executives I (Farmer) and Sales to pursue them.
- Collaborate with internal teams (Operations, Product, Implementation) to resolve client issues and deliver consistent service quality.
- Review client performance data to identify trends and potential risks, bringing data-informed insights to your regular client conversations.
- Build foundational knowledge of Flexport's product suite and global trade operations to credibly advise clients on core logistics challenges.
- Work closely with Hunters from the beginning of the customer journey to ensure a seamless transition and long-term client success.
You should have:
- 1+ years of experience in account management, direct sales, client success, operations, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background a plus.
- A demonstrated ability to build rapport and trust with clients, with a track record of strong satisfaction or relationship outcomes.
- Strong communication and listening skills, you ask good questions and follow through on commitments.
- Curiosity about how accounts grow and what drives client value; you're developing commercial instincts, not just executing tasks.
- Comfort working within defined processes and seeking guidance when situations are new or ambiguous.
- A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
You will get:

title: Production Assembler
description:

CORPORATE PROFILE
Illinois Tool Works (ITW) is an $16 billion, multi-national, publicly traded (NYSE) company headquartered in Glenview, Illinois.
ITW has a strong commitment to operational excellence and innovation that has kept the company on a path of strong financial performance for more than 10 years.  The company is built on a differentiated business model comprised of three unique core capabilities:  our 80/20 business process, sustainable differentiation and our entrepreneurial culture.  These have long been the core of who ITW is as a company and the source of our ability to deliver value-added solutions for our customers and differentiated financial performance for our shareholders.

Core customers are Airports and Airlines in all countries around the World.

Sales Office Dubai

undefined

title: Sr. Accountant
description:

title: Technical Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Job Description:
The Customer Experience Representative works within the Customer Experience Department. The department focuses on the sales and service administration of the North American Business Unit. The position holder will be expected to create an exceptional customer experience while providing accurate and timely responses to customers and cross-functional teams. A working knowledge of industrial parts and their applications is essential to success in this role. Technical ability including the ability to read wiring diagrams and Bills of Materials is necessary.
Responsibilities:
Prepare quotations for spare parts and service calls using various proprietary software.
Process sales orders for standard equipment, service, and spare parts. This includes assessing incoming orders for correct shipping and billing information, the accurate entry of order details, and invoice creation. As well as order administration tasks, via customer updates, shipping notifications, and tracking information.
Ensure all service-related administration is completed as required. This includes logging of service visit requests, service order entry, and invoicing.
Coordinate effective communication with customers, both external and internal, ensuring accurate and timely resolution to all inquiries.
Pro-actively participate in ITW’s ‘toolbox’ initiatives.
This role will require the successful candidate to set and manage their own priorities, all with an eye towards continual improvement.

Requirements:
Ability to collect information and utilize available resources such as blueprints, schematics, bills of materials, and various engineering software to identify the part(s) needed.
Previous related experience working inside sales or customer support for major industrial suppliers/distributors helpful. Prior hands-on experience in field service support, technical repair, or an industrial trade also considered.  Exceptional critical-thinking skills, able to determine what is required independently and carry requests forward to successful resolution.
Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to triage competing priorities while maintaining efficiency and quality.
Positive and optimistic with a belief that “Better” is a daily possibility.
Willing to do what needs to be done, even if what needs to be done is outside of their usual workflow.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident with both internal and external individuals at all levels. Excellent telephone manners.
Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently in a fast-paced environment.
High proficiency in the use of Excel, SharePoint, and other Microsoft Office applications.

Platform Development
Help design, build, and maintain both the  frontend and backend  of a new internal AI-powered platform — from writing your first feature to seeing it run in production
Build and maintain  integrations  between the platform and cloud services, AI APIs, and internal data sources
Write clean, tested, and well-documented code across the full stack ( Python backend + React/TypeScript frontend )
AI & Automation
Integrate  generative AI and LLM capabilities  into the platform — helping business teams find information faster, answer questions, and automate repetitive tasks
Learn and apply  agentic and tool-calling patterns  with guidance from senior engineers

Work within  CI/CD pipelines  to build, test, and deploy features to production environments
Use  observability tools  (logging, monitoring, alerting) to understand how the platform is performing in the real world
Iteration & Improvement
Gather and act on  real user feedback  to improve features over time
Balance  speed and reliability  — shipping incrementally while maintaining production quality

Education
Bachelor's degree in  Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems , or a related technical field
Relevant coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Web Development, Cloud Computing, Databases, Software Engineering, or AI/ML
Technical Skills
Languages & Frameworks
Proficient in  Python  — coursework, projects, or internships

Familiarity with REST APIs and web application architecture

Introductory experience with a major cloud provider ( Azure, AWS, or GCP ) — even via free-tier projects or coursework
Basic understanding of  containerization  (Docker) and deployment concepts
Exposure to  CI/CD  concepts (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
AI / Generative AI
Awareness of  LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, etc.) — class projects, hackathons, or self-study
Curiosity about agentic patterns, tool-calling, and AI-powered workflows is a strong plus
Security & Auth
Conceptual understanding of  authentication and access control  (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC a plus, but not required)
Awareness of data privacy and secure coding practices
Soft Skills & Work Style
Eager to  collaborate with non-technical stakeholders  — can translate business needs into technical requirements with guidance
Comfortable  asking questions and iterating  — doesn't need perfect specs to get started

This role supports global real estate strategy, long-range planning, portfolio scenario modeling, and investment analysis to help inform enterprise growth, space planning, and capital allocation decisions.
The Manager, Real Estate & Strategic Planning will help develop integrated, data-driven real estate strategies by connecting business demand, headcount and space requirements, portfolio options, operational constraints, and financial implications. The role works closely with REWS leadership and collaborates with Global Operations, Logistics, Operational Industrial Engineering, Construction, Workplace Services, Finance, and other REWS stakeholders.
This position contributes to the speed, quality, consistency, and transparency of real estate decision support. The Manager will support standardization and automation of space-planning models, develop scenarios and leadership-ready recommendations, engage proactively with business partners, and help prepare analysis in advance of major occupancy, expansion, and capital decisions.
Essential Job Duties
Real Estate Portfolio Strategy
·       Maintain and support the strategic view of the global real estate portfolio, including current-state needs, future demand, constraints, risks, and opportunities.
·       Support portfolio strategies that align real estate decisions with enterprise growth, operational requirements, and long-term financial objectives.
·       Identify and evaluate strategic options for expansions, consolidations, relocations, renewals, and other portfolio actions.
·       Coordinate real estate strategy development activities with execution teams and help ensure decisions, assumptions, and accountability are clearly documented.
·       Contribute to process improvements and knowledge-sharing practices that strengthen REWS planning capability.
Long-Range Planning & Scenario Modeling

·   Partner with FP&A on financial modeling and investment analysis for real estate alternatives.

·   Prepare fact-based recommendations that balance business requirements, operational feasibility, portfolio strategy, and financial viability.
·   Maintain transparent assumptions, source references, and model documentation.

·       Serve as a planning and strategy partner across REWS and collaborate with Global Operations, Logistics, Operational Industrial Engineering, Construction, Workplace Services, and Finance.
·       Support operating rhythms, planning inputs, decision processes, and escalation paths that strengthen accountability and reduce organizational friction.
·   Engage stakeholders early to understand business scope, identify needs in advance, and develop long-term solutions rather than reactive responses.
·   Align stakeholders around a common set of assumptions, scenarios, recommendations, and leadership messages.
Executive Communication & Decision Support

·       Communicate risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and recommended actions in a concise and consistent manner.
·       Support leadership discussions and respond to planning requests with coordinated, high-quality analysis.

·   Identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses and improve the speed, quality, and usability of portfolio planning outputs.
·   Perform additional duties and strategic projects as assigned.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience creating or improving repeatable planning and reporting solutions.
·       Demonstrated proficiency using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity, automate recurring planning workflows, identify insights from complex data sets, and accelerate development of executive-ready real estate strategy materials.

·       Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is searching for a Mechanical Engineer to help design the endoscope system for a novel robotic surgical platform. As an early member of the team, this role is an exciting opportunity to help define the eventual product from early prototypes through clinical trials and into product launch.
Essential Job Duties
As part of the New Product Development team, the engineer will work with team members to:
Distal Tip and Vision Mechanical Design
Own the mechanical design of the endoscope distal tip and camera module, including housings, optical windows, lens and image-sensor mounts, illumination (LED and/or fiber-optic) integration, and sealing features
Design miniature, high-precision machined, injection-molded / micro-molded, and MIM components; perform tolerance stack-up analysis to achieve tight optical alignment and high assembly yield
Select materials, adhesives, and joining processes (e.g., precision bonding, laser welding, soldering) compatible with biocompatibility, sterilization, and reliability requirements
Prototyping, Test, and Supplier Development
Rapidly build, assemble, and test prototypes; analyze results and drive fast design iterations
Apply FEA and other modeling and simulation methods (structural, thermal, sealing) to key design elements and use results to inform design decisions
Design tooling and fixtures for assembly, optical alignment, and test
Work with suppliers to take parts from quick-turn prototypes to production-intent components, driving DFM/DFA, quality, and cost
Requirements, Documentation, and Design Controls
Translate system and user needs into mechanical requirements and specifications; contribute to risk management activities (e.g., dFMEA)
Create detailed drawings with GD&T and document designs, test protocols, and reports under design controls (ISO 13485, FDA QMSR / 21 CFR 820)
Support design verification, clinical builds, and design transfer to manufacturing
Generate and evaluate concepts for next-generation endoscopic and vision devices
Electro-Mechanical and Thermal Integration
Partner with electrical engineers to package flex / rigid-flex circuits, micro-coax cables, and connectors through the tip and shaft, managing bend radius, strain relief, and EMI shielding
Perform thermal analysis (first-principles calculations and simulation) of the tip and camera module; design heat-spreading paths and heat sinks so that image sensors, patient-contacting surfaces remain within component and IEC 60601 temperature limits
Plan and execute thermal characterization tests (e.g., thermocouples, IR thermography) and correlate results with models
Required Skills and Experience
4+ years of industry experience designing and delivering complex, precision mechanical assemblies (or 1+ years with an PhD)
Hands-on experience building, assembling, and testing prototypes and complex mechanical assemblies
Proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks strongly preferred) and detailed drawing creation
Working knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) / ISO drafting standards and tolerance stack-up analysis
Experience applying FEA and first-principles engineering analysis to the design of mechanical parts
Experience designing for machining and injection molding, and working directly with suppliers
Strong communication and documentation skills; proven ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, cross-functional team
Preferred Skills and Experience (Strong Plus)
Electro-mechanical system design: integrating PCBAs, flex / rigid-flex circuits, cabling, connectors, sensors, or actuators into compact mechanical packages
Thermal analysis and thermal management: heat-transfer calculations, heat sink / heat spreader sizing, and thermal simulation (e.g., ANSYS Icepak / Fluent, Simcenter FloTHERM, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Flow Simulation), with correlation to test data
Medical device development experience, particularly endoscopes, catheters, or other minimally invasive instruments, under ISO 13485 design controls
Knowledge of biocompatible materials (ISO 10993), sterilization / reprocessing methods, and sealing / ingress protection
Experience with micro-manufacturing processes such as Swiss-type machining, micro-molding, MIM, laser welding, and precision adhesive bonding
Familiarity with IEC 60601-1 and IEC 60601-2-18 (endoscopic equipment)
Scripting for data analysis or test automation (e.g., Python, MATLAB)

Intuitive Surgical designs and manufactures pioneering medical devices for use in surgery. These devices consist of surgical instruments, endoscopes, diagnostic tools, and accessories used on a robotic surgical platform. Each patient-contact device is evaluated for biological safety according to relevant international standards.  The Biological Safety Group at Intuitive are responsible for the definition, implementation, and communication of our biological safety program under the guidance of board-certified toxicologists.
The Biosafety Development Engineer is responsible for managing and collaborating with teams in support of the biological safety evaluation process for new products and changes to existing products. The successful candidate must excel in a high-energy, small-focused team environment, be a quick learner, and have a commitment to high product quality. The candidate must have a strong understanding of toxicology and analytical chemistry requirements for evaluating the biological safety of medical devices. The candidate should possess experience in designing and implementing biocompatibility safety evaluations, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, laboratory techniques, in vitro and in vivo test methods, and chemical analyses. The candidate should have experience in planning, tracking, creating process and procedure and implementing activities for the biological safety evaluation of medical devices, adhering to ISO 10993 guidelines. The candidate should have understating and knowledge of global regulatory requirements, compliance, quality management systems, audits, standards, and test methods for the biological safety evaluation and risk assessment of medical devices.
A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required and the ability to make work fun and interesting.  Supporting you will be a technical services management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Work closely with toxicologists and other specialists to support and implement the biological safety program at Intuitive; collaborate with biosafety group members to develop safety assessment plans.
Serve as the biological safety representative for new product development teams; attend meetings; communicate schedules; present at design reviews; and be responsible for peer interactions with engineering. With excellent organizational skills, prioritization abilities, and effective communication with project stakeholders, play a crucial role in managing multiple projects concurrently, ensuring the fulfillment of all compliance requirements.
Responsible for closely monitoring and ensuring that all processes and procedures are in line with the biocompatibility requirements set by relevant regulatory bodies. This includes conducting assessments, reviewing documentation, and implementing necessary changes to achieve compliance.
Support sustaining and supplier engineering programs by collecting information on design changes for patient-contact materials and coordinating the execution of biological safety assessment plans.
Responsible for continuously reviewing and updating biological safety processes and procedures based on current standards. This includes staying informed about the latest regulatory requirements and industry best practices to ensure our standards remain accurate and up to date.
